before: Older-mode percentage tables used the content-aligned reference box only when left-aligned or centered, unindented, AutoFit, and confirmed by the grid.
after: Older-mode tables use the reference box for every alignment, indent, layout, and direction, including tables without a usable width; AutoFit tables without a width fit the room their indent leaves; a mode declared outside the compat element applies.
reason: Only layout geometry changes. Document nodes, text offsets, operations, room formats, and package serialization stay the same.
